sources.title: Open-source AI Models for Any Application | Llama 3
sources.snippet: Discover Llama 3's open-source AI models you can fine-tune, distill and deploy anywhere. Build smarter applications with flexible AI solutions.

sources.title: Introducing Llama 3.1: Our most capable models to date - Meta AI
sources.snippet: Bringing open intelligence to all, our latest models expand context length, add support across eight languages, and include Meta Llama 3.1 405B— the first frontier-level open source AI model.

sources.title: Introducing LLaMA: A foundational, 65-billion-parameter language model
sources.snippet: Today, we're releasing our LLaMA (Large Language Model Meta AI) foundational model with a gated release. LLaMA is more efficient and competitive with previously published models of a similar size on existing benchmarks.

sources.title: Unmatched Performance and Efficiency | Llama 4
sources.snippet: Meet Llama 4, the latest multimodal AI model offering cost efficiency, 10M context window and easy deployment. Start building advanced personalized experiences.

sources.title: Llama (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Llama[a] (" Large Language Model Meta AI " serving as a backronym) was a family of large language models (LLMs) released by Meta AI starting in February 2023. [3] Llama models come in different sizes, ranging from 1 billion to 2 trillion parameters. Initially only a foundation model, [4] starting with Llama 2, Meta AI released instruction fine-tuned versions alongside foundation models. [5 ...
